user_story: As a user, I want to upload a file so that I can share documents through the application. I also want to be able to download a sample file provided by the application. Acceptance Criteria: When a user selects a file using the input field with id 'uploadFile', the file should be uploaded successfully. The user should also be able to click the 'Download' button (class 'btn btn-primary') to download a sample file.
